title: One Neural Operator for Re-planning Low-Thrust Cislunar Transfers after Thrust Outages, at the Original or a Later Arrival
abstract: arXiv:2611.33188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safe-mode events causing thrust outages are common in missions with electric propulsion. To demonstrate mission feasibility in such an event, missed-thrust margin studies are performed where thousands of outage scenarios need an exact re-plan solved. We train a neural operator that maps a nominal trajectory with an outage profile to a re-planned trajectory and to the probability that the recovery exists, for 270 low-thrust near-rectilinear halo orbit (NRHO) to distant retrograde orbit (DRO) transfers, at an allowed slip of up to 10 days. On unseen transfers and zero slip, its median control error on the severe half of outages is 1.20% compared to 14.0% for the best cheap re-planner benchmark. With the arrival slip as an input, the error is 1.67% against 23.2%. translated_title: 一种用于在推力中断后重新规划低推力地月转移的神经算子：支持原定到达或延迟到达
translated_abstract: 安全模式事件导致的推力中断在电推进任务中十分常见。为了证明任务在此类事件下的可行性，需要进行错过推力裕度研究，其中需要对数千种中断场景求解精确的重新规划方案。我们训练了一个神经算子，它能够将带有中断轮廓的标称轨迹映射到重新规划的轨迹以及恢复方案存在的概率，涵盖270条低推力近直线晕轨道（NRHO）到远距离逆行轨道（DRO）的转移，允许最多10天的到达时间滑移。在未见过的转移和零滑移情况下，该算子在最严重一半中断场景上的中位控制误差为1.20%，而最佳廉价重新规划基准方法为14.0%。当将到达滑移作为输入时，误差为1.67%，对比基准方法的23.2%。它还能预测给定到达滑移下中断的可恢复性，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）达到0.997，而最低恢复（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文训练了一个神经算子，能够在电推进任务发生推力中断后即时重新规划低推力地月转移轨迹（支持原定到达或最多延后10天到达），其控制误差比传统快速重规划基准低约一个数量级，并能以0.997的AUC准确预测中断的可恢复性。
en_tdlr: The paper trains a neural operator that instantly re-plans low-thrust cislunar transfers after thrust outages (at the original or a later arrival), achieving an order-of-magnitude lower control error than fast re-planning benchmarks while predicting outage recoverability with an AUC of 0.997.
